body:
## Hotfix v2.0.4

### Fixed
- **Clone glow artifact**: Removed unnecessary MeshRenderer/MeshFilter that rendered uninitialized geometry → caused yellow glow on remote player clone
- **Rim light always-on**: AdaptiveRimLight now OFF by default, only activates during dash (was constantly emitting light)
- **Sorting layer sync**: Now syncs via tk2dSprite renderer instead of bare MeshRenderer

### Added
- F10/F11 diagnostic logging to identify input system issues (Legacy vs New Input System)
- One-time startup diagnostic in Update() to verify MonoBehaviour lifecycle

**Download:** SilksongCoop_v2.0.4.zip — extract to game folder, overwrite existing files.

**After launch:** Check BepInEx/LogOutput.log for [Coop] diagnostic messages about input systems.
name: v2.0.4 - Clone Glow Fix + F10/F11 Diagnostics
